asset_set: Questionnaire Q5 option 1 — Writing fantasy novel chapters

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under notebook and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; faint wavy scribble lines suggesting handwriting on page only
art_style.mood: cozy imaginative-writer energy — approachable storytelling hobby, not a formal publishing office
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: KursoKo gold
accent.use: dragon figurine scale highlights, pen nib band, cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: ink bottle glass tint, feather quill barb accents

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: gold appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on ink bottle glass and dragon figurine scales
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and notebook edge

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: holds an open notebook page steady
left_hand.grip: flat fingers pressing the page corner down
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: writes a new line of wavy scribble text with a fountain pen
right_hand.grip: relaxed tripod pen grip, nib touching the page
right_hand.position: center-right, mid-stroke on the open page

pose.gesture_summary: mid-writing freeze frame — pen mid-stroke on a fresh chapter line
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands writes a fresh line of a fantasy story in an open notebook, pen mid-stroke across a page of wavy handwriting scribbles. A tiny gold dragon figurine perches beside a lavender-tinted ink bottle and a loose feather quill, capturing the cozy magic of building an imaginary world one chapter at a time.

primary_objects.name: open notebook with handwriting
primary_objects.detail: wavy scribble lines suggesting cursive handwriting, no readable words, small ink smudge in corner

primary_objects.name: small dragon figurine
primary_objects.detail: curled tail, tiny wings, simplified faceted scales

primary_objects.name: ink bottle
primary_objects.detail: lavender-tinted glass with a visible ink level line

primary_objects.name: feather quill
primary_objects.size_relative: small accent — resting across notebook spine
primary_objects.detail: simple curved barbs, decorative rather than in-use

subject.environment: light birch desk surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no bookshelf backdrop

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from dragon figurine → notebook page → writing hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: notebook silhouette + dragon shape + two hands readable at 160px width
